purpose: One family taxonomy for settings surfaces: what a setting IS decides where it LIVES. Canonical per ADR-0033 / ADR-0031 (sync-and-gate): this file is the master; product repos vendor it byte-identical under contracts/ and scripts/verify-wiring.sh flags drift. A setting may not ship (or move) in any product without a domain entry (or adopter line) here.

ai.title: AI — model access & assignment
ai.membership: If the setting names a provider endpoint, a model-API key, a model row, or a capability-to-model assignment slot, it is ai.*. Nothing else may live under the AI tab — not web search, not discovery, not integrations, not behavior knobs.

tools.title: Tools — non-model capabilities
tools.membership: If the assistant invokes it at run time as a capability/tool and it is not a model, it is tools.*: web search providers, discovery sources, scanned sources, translation, indexing, memories, the tool catalog, connectors, skills. Decision and agent BEHAVIOR (thresholds, scope, rules, iterations) lives here too — their SETUP (provider, model, assignment) stays in ai.* (ADR-0032).

automations.title: Automations — scheduled autonomous runs
automations.membership: If the setting defines or schedules an autonomous run (prompt or mini-app schedule, saved-search digest rhythms: interval/daily/weekly/cron, timezone, enable), it is automations.*.

app.title: App-level — the product itself
app.membership: Settings about the product rather than the assistant's capabilities: general/appearance/language, account & security, data (backup/export/trash), users (admin), developer/diagnostics, voice I/O, hotkeys, commands, mini-apps, notifications. Family-constrained only by the naming and i18n rules; product-specific tabs are declared per product below.

domains.title: AI providers (BYOK)
domains.definition: Provider rows: endpoint + API key per model API. Preset-driven one-click setup (ai-presets.json contract).
domains.secrets: product secret store (OS keyring / Fernet atrest) — never a plaintext column

domains.title: Models
domains.definition: Model rows per provider: external id, label, capabilities, decision transport seam.

domains.title: Task assignments
domains.definition: Capability/task → model slots (text/vision/stt/tts/embeddings), the decision default slot (decision) and its decision:<kind> override slots, primary + fallback — resolution per ADR-0036 (kind override → decision default → unassigned). Capability defaults are single-slot per ADR-0037 (fallbacks live only on specialist assignments: task rows and decision:<kind> overrides). Includes the decision-group privacy note.

domains.title: Web search
domains.definition: Web search provider(s) behind the assistant's search/fetch tools: flavor/type, base URL, key, ordering/fallback.
domains.secrets: product secret store — never a plaintext column

adopters.desktop-assistant: aligned (section id 'search': ordered multi-provider list; catalog + fixtures vendored, parity wall — plan 28 Phase 3)
adopters.study-assistant: aligned (multi-provider family shape since plan 28 Phase 1: ordered providers[] + vendored adapter core, ADR-0035)
adopters.career-assistant: aligned (ordered providers[] shape + catalog since plan 28 Phase 4; career's SSRF-guarded searxng transport stays app-side — searxng ships, keyed POST providers wait for guarded adapters)

domains.title: Discovery
domains.definition: Discovery sources & toggles: built-in channels (web, youtube) and site presets (site:<domain> with kind).

adopters.career-assistant: n/a (saved-search digests are automations, not discovery)

domains.title: Web sources
domains.definition: Periodically scanned external sources (rss, youtube_channel, youtube_playlist, site_search) with scan intervals.

domains.title: Local indexing
domains.definition: Local content processing for retrieval: semantic-search (embeddings) toggle, OCR image limits.

domains.title: Decision behavior
domains.definition: How the assistant decides: act/confirm thresholds, scope, route tools, prompt steer, rules, version pinning. Setup (provider/model/assignment) is ai.* (ADR-0032) — only behavior lives here.

domains.title: Memories
domains.definition: Memory stores the assistant reads/writes at run time.

domains.title: Tool catalog
domains.definition: The tool surface itself: enable/disable per tool, risk classes, verification, folders, usage.

domains.title: Connectors (MCP client + job sources)
domains.definition: External tool servers the assistant can call (MCP client connectors) AND job-source connectors (posting ingestion sources with catalog-driven config; plan 32 Phase 1 / ADR-0040) — one connectors section covers both connector-kind surfaces.
domains.secrets: product secret store — never a plaintext column

adopters.study-assistant: aligned (connectors section manages MCP server instances — D19 rows with keyring token/env slots, per-tool allowlists, explicit refresh — plus the read-only MCP resource-server info card, ADR-0012; plan 32 Phase 7)
adopters.career-assistant: aligned (admin tools tab → connectors section: MCP GitHub token + job-source connector instances with x-secret slots and per-source probes, plan 32 Phase 1; extension sources — git import, consent, pins — ride the same section since Phase 3)

domains.title: Skills
domains.definition: Skill packs: import/enable skill bundles the assistant can use.

domains.title: Agent behavior
domains.definition: Agentic run knobs that are not model assignment (e.g. max reasoning iterations).

adopters.health-assistant/core: aligned (tenant/system tools pages since plan 27 Phase 4; legacy ai-config ?tab=agent redirects)

domains.title: Automations
domains.definition: Scheduled autonomous runs: prompt/mini-app schedules with interval/daily/weekly/cron rhythms, timezone, enable, last-run.

adopters.career-assistant: aligned (tab id 'automations' since plan 27 Phase 3; legacy /settings/scheduler redirects)

invariants: INV-1: An 'aligned' surface hosts only domains whose group matches its tab's group. The AI tab hosts exactly ai.* domains.
INV-2: Web search provider config (tools.web-search) never appears under AI providers, models, or tasks.
INV-3: Behavior (tools.decisions, tools.agent) never carries setup; setup (key, model, assignment) never carries behavior.
INV-4: Secrets for ai.* and tools.* domains go to the product secret store (OS keyring on desktop, Fernet atrest / keyring seal on web) — never plaintext config or preference JSON.
INV-5: Tab and section ids are kebab-case ASCII; labels resolve through the product's i18n layer (settings.tabs.<id> pattern where the app has i18n keys).
INV-6: Web deep links use ?tab=<id>&section=<id>; desktop navigates via the settings-shell navigate contract. Legacy ids redirect, never 404.
INV-7: A product's declared nav (products block) matches its actual UI arrays — enforced by a per-product conformance test against the vendored copy of this file.
INV-8: New settings classify here before the UI ships: the PR adds the domain entry (or an adopter line) in the same wave.
